summary:
Full re-derivation against fingerprint 0662c9e1. The prior 13/13 was treated as prior claims to re-test, and its retracted 'the BUILD did not change' annotation was inherited in NEITHER direction. 13/13 PASS.

THE DEPLOY-FIDELITY GAP IS CLOSED, ON FIRST-HAND EVIDENCE RATHER THAN A TASK RECORD: GitHub Actions run 32427236326 for ba0cd91 ran in real PUBLISH mode ('Event=push dry_run=false', 'MODE: PUBLISH') and logged 'Published Notebook silver_to_gold' 23:06:56Z and 'Published Notebook bronze_ingest_wgi' 23:06:57Z, concluding success — so both artifacts ba0cd91 changed ARE live. At verification time HEAD (2873cc1) was 1 commit ahead of origin/main and unpushed, but touches ZERO fabric/ files (probed with two positive controls), so repo fabric/ at HEAD was identical to what was published.

The prior run's major finding — task-074's grain guard unreachable — is FIXED and re-derived locally, not accepted: ba0cd91 restructures it into guard (A) counting the PRE-dedup frame plus guard (B) on the dedup key, and tests/test_data_quality.py::TestDataGapsGrainGuard drives the NOTEBOOK'S OWN create_data_gaps_table via load_notebook_functions over a fixture with a duplicated country_key, asserting the ValueError fires with '5 rows for 4 distinct countries' AND that nothing was written. Suite: 349 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped in 60.08s (conftest sets spark.sql.ansi.enabled=false, matching Fabric).

Every one of task-076's spec corrections was re-measured against reality, not accepted: bronze_wgi retry is 0 and pipeline_error_handler is 0 in pipeline-content.json (range 0-3 confirmed across all 10 activities); test_data_quality.py collects exactly 54; the suite is exactly 349; docs/data_quality_framework.md § 7 now reads 'Two', agreeing with spec L1122 and data_quality_architecture.md — the prior run's self-contradiction is resolved.

NEW FINDING THE RECORD DID NOT HOLD: the live workspace contains two items absent from source control — Notebook/Notebook_1 and DataPipeline/tmp_task064_seed — enumerated by the same deploy run at 23:07:16Z (12 repo items vs 15 deployed; the third, SQLEndpoint/oem_lh, is Fabric-generated and benign). docs/architecture/fabric-artifacts-inventory.md L51 asserts Notebook_1 was 'Removed 2026-08-10', which the 2026-08-20 enumeration falsifies; tmp_task064_seed appears nowhere in that inventory, and task-069's own record says it held rollback DDL that 'would have silently undone the fix while reporting success'. *** THAT PREMISE WAS FALSIFIED BY THE ORCHESTRATOR AFTER THIS RUN: the LIVE pipeline definition was fetched 2026-08-21 and its CREATE TABLE reads DECIMAL(18,2) on both columns, matching azure/procurement.sql. SMALLINT/FLOAT survive only in a stale comment header. The pipeline is still destructive (DROP + reseed) and still undocumented, but it does NOT revert the schema fix. See task-079, whose description carries the measured correction. *** So 'repo equals live workspace' holds in the repo-to-workspace direction and is freshly proven, but NOT in the workspace-to-repo direction. Raised as task-079.

SCOPE LIMIT, STATED PLAINLY: verify-agent holds no Fabric credentials. It could not query the lakehouse, the semantic model, or the pipeline run history. Criteria 1, 2, 4, 8 rest on live evidence recorded by others in task JSONs plus repo-internal corroboration — and critically, NO scheduled or manual pipeline run against the post-ba0cd91 silver_to_gold has been observed. The deploy is proven; the subsequent execution of the new code is not.

supersedes.note: The 2026-08-20 13/13 was re-derived, not inherited. Two things had moved since it was stamped: the spec (task-076's corrections, now committed as 2873cc1) and the BUILD (commit ba0cd91 modified silver_to_gold and bronze_ingest_wgi AFTER that pass). That prior record carried an annotation claiming 'The BUILD did not change'; the claim was false, was caught by task-076's verification, and was retracted in place before this run.
supersedes.how_the_retracted_gap_actually_resolved: The retraction was correct — the 'build did not change' claim WAS false — but the gap it opened read wider than it was. This run established from the GitHub Actions log that ba0cd91 deployed in real PUBLISH mode about 23 minutes after it was committed, so both changed notebooks were already live in the workspace BEFORE the supersession note was written. Deploy fidelity was never actually broken; what was broken was the record's basis for asserting it. Logged as a false_positive friction marker so the supersession-annotation habit is calibrated, not abandoned.

post_run_corrections.what: The NEW FINDING in this run's summary inherited task-069's characterisation of DataPipeline/tmp_task064_seed as holding SMALLINT/FLOAT rollback DDL. A live getDefinition fetch showed the script's CREATE TABLE is DECIMAL(18,2) on both columns — matching the repo contract — with SMALLINT/FLOAT appearing only in a stale comment header. The finding that the item is live and undocumented STANDS; the characterisation of its danger does not.
post_run_corrections.also_confirmed: Both orphans (Notebook_1, tmp_task064_seed) verified still present in the live workspace on 2026-08-21 via the Fabric items API — upgrading this from a deploy-log inference to a first-hand measurement. Of the inventory doc's eight 'removed 2026-08-10' rows, Notebook_1 is the only one falsified.
